content.title: Canada's BCE expects to save C$1.5 billion in costs by 2028
content.summary: The company unveiled the new target as part of a three-year plan at its investor day on Tuesday - its first in more than a decade.  It also expects to achieve about 15% compounded annual growth in free cash flow after lease liabilities between 2025 and 2028.  The company sees further cost savings in 2029 and beyond as it exits legacy services by decommissioning copper-based network infrastructure and moves to new technologies like fiber that require less maintenance.
